title: Specialist Cloud Database Engineer (SQL, DevOps, AWS)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>Database DevOps &amp; Release Engineer</strong></p> <p><strong>So, what’s the role all about?</strong></p> <p>We're hiring a Database DevOps &amp; Release Engineer for our Data Engineering and Database Operations team. This role goes beyond traditional DBA work: you'll need strong SQL and T-SQL skills, working knowledge of DevOps and GitOps principles, and ownership of how database changes get built, reviewed, packaged, and deployed.</p> <p>You'll review and approve pull requests for database changes, package those changes (DDL, stored procedures, functions, and CLR/assembly changes) into deployable artifacts using DACPAC, SLN, and manifest files, and build and manage the CI/CD pipelines that deploy them alongside production application code. You'll also handle database support for our lower and lab environments, so replication, high availability, and backup/restore skills matter as much as your DevOps background.</p> <p><strong>How will you make an impact?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Review and approve pull requests for database changes, ensuring code quality, standards, and deployability before merge.</li> <li>Package database changes (DDL, stored procedures, functions, and CLR/assembly changes) into deployable artifacts using DACPAC, SLN, and manifest files.</li> <li>Build, manage, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for database deployments from inception to end of life, using Jenkins and GitHub Actions/Workflows.</li> <li>Coordinate database deployments so they roll out alongside production application code changes.</li> <li>Apply GitOps principles to database change management, including branching strategy, pull request workflows, and version-controlled deployment of schema and code changes.</li> <li>Use Redgate SQL Compare to identify and validate schema changes as part of the deployment and PR review process.</li> <li>Develop and optimize SQL and T-SQL scripts, stored procedures, functions, and other database objects.</li> <li>Act as the primary database support resource for lower/lab environments, troubleshooting deployment-related issues as well as general database issues.</li> <li>Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot SQL Server Replication environments, including Transactional Replication (mandatory) and Merge Replication (mandatory).</li> <li>Support and troubleshoot AlwaysOn Availability Groups and other high-availability solutions.</li> <li>Perform database backup, restore, disaster recovery, and routine maintenance activities.</li> <li>Perform root cause analysis and resolve database performance bottlenecks.</li> <li>Monitor database environments using tools such as SolarWinds DPA or equivalent monitoring platforms.</li> <li>Provision, configure, maintain, and support AWS RDS for MySQL and Amazon Aurora (MySQL-compatible) database environments.</li> <li>Troubleshoot and maintain SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) packages and ETL workflows.</li> <li>Partner with R&amp;D architects and developers to define database deployment standards and best practices across SQL Server and Amazon Aurora RDS.</li> <li>Develop automation scripts and operational tooling, primarily using Python (PowerShell as needed).</li> <li>Participate in Agile ceremonies including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and technical discussions.</li> <li>Contribute to continuous improvement of the database deployment pipeline and operational practices.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Have you got what it takes?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>8+ years of professional experience in database engineering or administration, with strong exposure to DevOps/CI-CD practices.</li> <li>Advanced knowledge of SQL and T-SQL programming.</li> <li>Solid understanding of DevOps and GitOps principles as applied to database change management.</li> <li>Experience performing code reviews and approving pull requests for database changes.</li> <li>Hands-on experience deploying database changes, including DDL, stored procedures, and functions.</li> <li>Experience with CLR/Assembly deployment is a plus.</li> <li>Fundamental understanding of DACPAC, SLN, and manifest files, and how they're used to package database changes into a deployable artifact for release alongside application code.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools, specifically Jenkins and GitHub Actions/Workflows, and comfort building and managing pipelines from inception through end of life.</li> <li>Solid experience with Git-based source control workflows, including branching, merging, pull requests, and code review.</li> <li>Experience with Redgate SQL Compare or similar schema comparison tooling; familiarity with Flyway, Liquibase, or similar database deployment/migration tools is a plus.</li> <li>Strong experience with SQL Server Replication: <ul> <li>Transactional Replication (mandatory)</li> <li>Merge Replication (mandatory)</li> </ul> </li> <li>Hands-on expertise in high availability, including AlwaysOn Availability Groups troubleshooting.</li> <li>Experience with database backup, restore, disaster recovery, and root cause analysis.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with AWS RDS and Aurora MySQL (mandatory).</li> <li>Experience supporting and troubleshooting SSIS packages and ETL processes.</li> <li>Strong experience with scripting and automation using Python (PowerShell a plus).</li> <li>Familiarity with monitoring tools such as SolarWinds DPA or similar platforms.</li> <li>Good understanding of cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services and/or Microsoft Azure is an advantage.</li> <li>Experience with Infrastructure as Code and provisioning tools such as AWS CloudFormation and Spacelift is an advantage.</li> <li>Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills.</li> <li>Experience working in Agile environments and collaborating with cross-functional teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What’s in it for you?</strong></p> <p>You'll work alongside engineers and architects who own database deployment tooling end to end, with room to shape how database changes ship into production.</p> <p>This role offers opportunities to:</p> <ul> <li>Build and own database CI/CD pipelines, applying DevOps/GitOps practices to how database changes ship.</li> <li>Work across SQL Server, AWS RDS, and Amazon Aurora.</li> <li>Collaborate with global teams and R&amp;D stakeholders on deployment tooling and day-to-day database support.</li> <li>Build expertise in CI/CD, release engineering, replication, and high-availability architectures.</li> <li>Grow into Senior, Lead, and Principal-level roles as you build your track record here.</li> </ul> You will function as an integrated part of a cross-functional engineering team, combining the proactive service management mindset of an Application Operations Engineer with the automation-first philosophy of a DevOps practitioner.</p> <p>You will be responsible for keeping production environments healthy and performant, while simultaneously designing and maintaining the CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code frameworks, and tooling that enable rapid, high-quality software delivery. You are the connective tissue between engineering, platform, and operations — someone who is equally comfortable in an incident bridge call and a sprint planning meeting.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>How will you make an impact? </strong>&nbsp;</p> <h2>DevOps &amp; Automation</h2> <ul> <li>Design, build, and maintain continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for rapid, quality-assured deployment of software deliverables.</li> <li>Build and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as CloudFormation, Ansible, Terraform, Chef, or Puppet.</li> <li>Manage day-to-day operations of release pipelines, build tools, artifact repositories, and source control systems.</li> <li>Coordinate build and release activities with engineering, QA, product, and other stakeholders across the organisation.</li> <li>Identify, research, and prototype new technologies and practices to continuously improve DevOps processes and team efficiency.</li> <li>Maintain and upgrade DevOps systems in both production and non-production environments on an ongoing basis.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Cloud &amp; Application Operations</h2> <ul> <li>Proactively monitor infrastructure and application health — including CPU, memory, file systems, databases, batch jobs, and network performance — and respond swiftly to anomalies.</li> <li>Identify and resolve operational issues including infrastructure failures, batch processing errors, network disruptions, and client data feed problems.</li> <li>Troubleshoot and respond to production downtime, performance degradation, and security-related incidents in a timely, structured manner.</li> <li>Perform end-to-end operational duties covering application server health, service availability, and platform integrity in accordance with documented processes and runbooks.</li> <li>Review and manage client service request tickets in adherence to defined SLAs, ensuring accountability and timely resolution.</li> <li>Provide on-call off-hour support as part of a structured rotation, including during non-prime and weekend shift windows as required.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Documentation, Communication &amp; You will help identify and build use cases that turn insights into measurable operational improvements, creating capabilities for customer demonstrations and future integration into NiCE production products.</p> <p>This is a <strong>hands-on product role</strong>. You will define and maintain a focused roadmap under the direction of product leadership while also building the application. This includes front-end development, API and connector integrations, maintaining and refactoring existing and AI-generated code, and connecting analytics outputs to application workflows.</p> <p>You will also serve as a central resource as prototype capabilities move toward production, partnering with Research, Product, Services, Design, Engineering, and other teams to ensure successful transition and avoid rediscovery. Customer and field feedback will help inform roadmap and prioritization decisions.</p> <p>The ideal candidate combines product judgment with hands-on technical skills. They are comfortable with ambiguity, energized by AI-assisted development, able to prioritize with incomplete information, and comfortable working across technical and business teams.</p> <h2>Primary Functions/Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li> <p>Own the Automated Insights prototype across definition, planning, release, enhancements, and maintenance.</p> </li> <li> <p>Define and maintain a focused roadmap and prioritize functionality under product leadership.</p> </li> <li> <p>Build new features and application modules from prototypes and specifications.</p> </li> <li> <p>Maintain, refactor, and improve existing and AI-generated code.</p> </li> <li> <p>Build data visualizations and dashboard-style interfaces from designs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Develop and manage API, webhook, and connector integrations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Connect Python-based analytics outputs to application workflows.</p> </li> <li> <p>Support prototype capabilities as they transition into production, partnering with cross-functional teams.</p> </li> <li> <p>Document functionality, dependencies, limitations, and technical considerations for receiving teams.</p> </li> <li> <p>Support customer-facing demonstrations, troubleshooting, and rapid issue resolution.</p> </li> <li> <p>Capture feedback from customers, field teams, and product teams to inform prioritization.</p> </li> <li> <p>Support application scalability, performance, reliability, version control, and CI/CD practices.</p> </li> <li> <p>Support other innovation projects, prototypes, solutions, and deployments as needed.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Required Education</strong></h3> <p>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Business Intelligence/Analytics, or a related field.</p> <p>Equivalent practical experience in a hands-on product or software development role may be considered in place of a degree.</p> <h3>Required Experience/Skills</h3> <ul> <li> <p>3+ years of combined experience in product ownership, product management, or hands-on application development, including ownership through multiple release cycles.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience defining and prioritizing a roadmap and making trade-off decisions with incomplete information.</p> </li> <li> <p>Hands-on experience with GenAI coding tools such as Claude Code or similar.</p> </li> <li> <p>Proficiency in JavaScript and modern front-end frameworks, preferably React, including HTML and CSS.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience building data visualizations or dashboard-style interfaces.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with REST APIs, authentication, webhooks, and connector integrations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Working knowledge of Python sufficient to read analytics code and interpret data science outputs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Working knowledge of Git and CI/CD practices.</p> </li> <li> <p>Ability to take ownership of and improve code they did not originally write.</p> </li> <li> <p>Familiarity with rapid prototyping tools and practices.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience partnering cross-functionally to move concepts into production.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills.</p> </li> <li> <p>Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and adapt to a changing environment.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Preferred Experience</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Experience moving prototypes or proof-of-concepts into production.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with Customer Experience, Contact Center, CCaaS, WEM, or enterprise SaaS platforms.</p> </li> <li> <p>Exposure to conversational AI, title: AI QA Automation Lead
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>So, what’s the role all about?</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a strong AI QA Automation Lead with high technical skills to build methodology, provide vision and direction, and lead quality &amp; automation throughout the organization. This role operates at the intersection of traditional software quality and AI-powered development: owning quality not just for code written by humans, but for systems designed, generated, and executed by AI agents.</p> <p><strong><br>How will you make an impact?&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Serve as the quality leader for an entire domain, accountable for product quality across human-written, AI-generated, and agent-executed software</span></li> <li>Actively track the domain’s quality tasks, analyze the testing needs, and define QA activities and ownership</li> <li>Continuously analyze and challenge existing testing coverage</li> <li>Plan, develop, and execute test strategy across our&nbsp;Cloud Analytics platform&nbsp;, extending to AI-powered and agentic system components</li> <li>Review and approve tests cases and complex system scenarios</li> <li><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Prepare and present data-driven quality insights, KPIs, risks, and trends to leadership through regular domain level reporting.</span></li> <li><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Lead domain-level RCA reviews for customer-facing bugs and major incidents; detect trends and drive systemic improvements.</span></li> <li><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Own post-deployment quality monitoring, drive sanity completion and rapid triage of production issues within the domain.</span></li> <li>Lead Quality assurance efforts that align with product objectives to ship products rapidly and with confidence</li> <li>Help the teams design the performance, concurrency and latency test scenarios and metrics</li> <li>Lead risk-based test strategy with product and engineering — define acceptance criteria and quality gates that support high delivery velocity without sacrificing customer-impacting quality</li> <li>Implement and evolve QA processes to get effective test signals and scale testing efforts across our services</li> <li>Define acceptance criteria for non-deterministic systems using golden-set evaluation, behavioral contracts, and statistical confidence thresholds</li> <li>Define adversarial and edge-case testing methodologies for AI features: prompt injection resistance, boundary condition handling, and graceful degradation</li> <li>Partner with engineering and DevOps teams to leverage automation for scalable solutions to prevent regressions and ensure reliability of product</li> <li>Track and improve CI/CD pipeline health across environments — expanding automation coverage, hardening test stability, and ensuring every environment produces trustworthy test signals.</li> <li>Plan and lead NFR testing</li> <li>Define guidelines and best practices for our automation and manual testing procedures</li> <li>Coordinate cross-organization/cross-region testing activities</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Have you got what it takes?</strong></p> <p><strong><u data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Education</u>:</strong></p> <ul> <li>BSc in Computer Science/Software Engineering or equivalent</li> <li>3 years QA Automation leadership experience: Team leader/Manager</li> <li>At least 4 years of automation experience</li> <li>Hands-on experience working within an agentic SDLC including AI-assisted code generation, agent-driven development workflows, and the quality, review, and governance practices that keep AI-accelerated delivery safe and reliable.</li> <li>Experience building AI-enabled automation workflows (e.g. Claude/OpenAI APIs, prompt patterns for test generation, repo-aware RAG, scripts/services that turn AI output into runnable tests)</li> <li>Experience with large scale production distributed systems and proven experience with designing and implementing tests for such systems</li> <li>Experience with systems that work with structured and unstructured data and with AI services and models</li> <li>Demonstrated technical leadership across teams — driving standards, roadmap execution, and stakeholder alignment</li> <li>Ability to define QA processes across development groups</li> <li>Hands on experience with CI/CD and Test-Driven Development</li> <li>Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills</li> <li>Experience with full software development lifecycle using&nbsp;<em>Agile</em>&nbsp;Development processes</li> <li>Experience designing evaluation harnesses for non-deterministic AI systems</li> <li>Cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and Infrastructure-as-Code</li> </ul> <p class="x_xfont-claude-response-body"><strong>Agentic AI &amp; LLM Proficiency</strong></p> <ul type="disc"> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Deep, hands-on understanding of agentic AI patterns: tool use, multi-agent orchestration, planning loops, memory architectures, and human-in-the-loop design</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Expert-level prompt engineering including chain-of-thought, few-shot, RAG, and structured output techniques applied to code and test generation</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Experience designing evaluation harnesses for non-deterministic AI systems — statistical confidence, behavioral consistency, and regression detection</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalents) and their tradeoffs in production quality pipelines</li> </ul> <p class="x_xfont-claude-response-body"><strong>Technical Depth</strong></p> <ul type="disc"> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Expert in Python and TypeScript; proficient in at least one compiled language (Java, Go, C#)</li> </ul> <div> <ul type="disc"> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Deep knowledge of modern test frameworks across UI, API, and contract layers: Playwright, Stryker, pytest, REST Assured, Pact</li> </ul> </div> <ul type="disc"> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Strong CI/CD architecture skills: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, pipeline-as-code, artifact management</li> </ul> <div> <ul type="disc"> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Proficient with cloud-native infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, serverless execution environments</li> </ul> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you?</strong></p> <p>Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!</strong></p> <p>At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. title: AI Transformation Strategist
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>So, what’s the role all about?</strong></p> <p>A NiCE&nbsp;<strong>AI Transformation Strategist</strong>&nbsp;sits at the intersection of enterprise strategy and hands-on AI agent delivery. You will primarily engage at the VP and Director level — with CX, Operations, Technology, and Digital leaders — to define transformation priorities and drive execution, while maintaining the executive fluency to contribute credibly in C-suite conversations when required.&nbsp;This is not a narrowly specialized role. You are expected to move fluidly between strategic advisory and agent development, combining structured problem-solving, conversational design, and customer insight to drive transformation from the program office to the build environment.</p> <p><strong>Core mandate:&nbsp;</strong><em>Partner with VP and Director-level leaders across CX, Operations, and Technology to define and execute AI-first transformation programs while directly building the agentic experiences that make that transformation real, leveraging NiCE's full platform to automate service, augment the workforce, and deliver intelligent experiences at enterprise scale.</em></p> <p><strong>How will you make an impact?&nbsp;</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li> <div class="x_x_elementToProof" data-ogsc="rgb(0, 0, 0)"> <p><strong>Strategic Advisory &amp; Transformation Planning</strong></p> <ul> <li>Engage primarily at the VP and Director level — across CX, Operations, Technology, and Digital functions — to define transformation priorities, align on approach, and drive program execution</li> <li>Build and maintain credibility with C-suite stakeholders when required, contributing to executive conversations with clarity and commercial rigor</li> <li>Define AI transformation roadmaps that connect agentic automation strategy to measurable business outcomes including cost efficiency, service quality, and operational scale</li> <li>Structure ambiguous business challenges into clear problem statements, workstreams, hypotheses, and recommendations that program owners can act on</li> <li>Facilitate alignment workshops, stakeholder interviews, and working sessions to gather input, challenge assumptions, and drive cross-functional agreement</li> <li>Develop business cases, transformation roadmaps, and senior-level materials that support high-stakes program decisions</li> <li>Contribute data-driven, strategic insights to customers and internal team decisions</li> <li>Contribute to NiCE's consulting IP, briefing materials, AI transformation playbooks, and vertical-specific accelerators</li> </ul> </div> </li> <li> <div class="x_x_elementToProof" data-ogsc="rgb(0, 0, 0)"> <p><strong>Agent Development &amp; Delivery</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with Agent Product Managers and Agent Engineers to scope, build, and ship conversational AI agents that handle thousands of customer conversations a day</li> <li>Design, build, and iteratively refine conversational AI agents from inception through deployment, combining product strategy with deep customer insight</li> <li>Drive execution and delivery of multiple complex, high-visibility agent development projects with clear milestones, owners, dependencies, and success metrics</li> <li>Coordinate across technical and non-technical stakeholders through the full agent development lifecycle</li> <li>Translate strategic transformation goals into agent architecture decisions and conversational design choices</li> <li>Architect the shift from traditional interaction management to fully orchestrated, AI-agentic workflows spanning front and back office</li> </ul> </div> </li> <li> <div class="x_x_elementToProof" data-ogsc="rgb(0, 0, 0)"> <p><strong>Change Enablement &amp; Execution</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and execute change management programs focused on people, process, technology, and organizational structure at enterprise scale</li> <li>Lead cloud migration strategy from on-premises contact center environments to NiCE CXone, mapping routing logic, agent states, reporting, and terminology</li> <li>Identify risks, interdependencies, and barriers to execution and recommend actions to improve delivery and adoption</li> <li>Translate strategic goals into execution plans and ensure clear communication across all stakeholders while developing strong, lasting relationships</li> </ul> </div> <ul> <li>AI strategy and agentic transformation: defining the enterprise vision for human-AI orchestration at scale</li> <li>Conversational AI agent development: scoping, designing, building, and iterating on AI agents across voice, digital, and async channels</li> <li>CX strategy and customer journey redesign from full automation of routine intent to complex end-to-end fulfillment</li> <li>Workforce augmentation: equipping employees with real-time AI intelligence to elevate performance and decision-making</li> <li>Cloud transformation and on-premises to CXone migration strategy and execution</li> <li>Operating model redesign, front and back office convergence, and workflow orchestration</li> <li>Interaction analytics and real-time intelligence deployment</li> <li>Compliance and financial crime transformation via NiCE Actimize for regulated industries<strong><br></strong></li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Required Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>5 to 10+ years in management consulting, transformation strategy, or enterprise technology advisory, with a proven track record of engaging and influencing at VP and Director level across CX, Operations, and Technology functions</li> <li>Demonstrated experience scoping, building, and shipping AI or conversational AI products, ideally in an agent development or product strategy capacity</li> <li>Demonstrable experience shaping AI or digital transformation programs at a senior program level, including building business cases that secure sponsorship and budget commitment</li> <li>Strong technical fluency: comfortable partnering with engineers and PMs on product architecture, conversational design, and agent development tradeoffs</li> <li>Deep familiarity with contact center ecosystems: ACD routing, IVR/IVA, workforce management, quality management, and omnichannel architecture</li> <li>Demonstrated experience leading cloud migration or digital transformation programs in a CCaaS, UCaaS, or enterprise SaaS context</li> <li>Outstanding verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey complex technical information to non-technical stakeholders and drive projects forward with clarity</li> <li>Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills to identify risks, develop mitigation strategies, and handle unexpected challenges across customer relationships and products</li> <li>Proficiency in change management frameworks (Prosci, ADKAR, or equivalent) and the ability to operationalize them at enterprise scale</li> <li>Comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution support in fast-moving, high-expectation environment</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Have you got what it takes?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field; MBA or comparable experience at the intersection of technology and operations is a strong plus</li> <li>Experience at a leading strategy or transformation consulting firm, or equivalent in-house enterprise transformation experience</li> <li>Hands-on experience with NiCE CXone, NiCE Actimize, or comparable enterprise CCaaS/WEM platforms</li> <li>Working knowledge of agentic AI architectures, large language model deployment, conversational AI, NLU, and real-time guidance technologies</li> <li>Certification in change management (Prosci CCP), project management (PMP / PRINCE2), or cloud architecture</li> <li>Prior experience as a practitioner inside a contact center, CX operations, or digital transformation function, not solely in an advisory capacity</li> </ul> <p><strong>What’s in title: Data Scientist, Actimize
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>So What’s the role all about?</strong></p> <p>We are looking for talented and motivated Data Scientists who are passionate about solving complex fraud‑related problems using advanced analytics and machine learning. You are someone who thrives on exploring large datasets, uncovering hidden patterns, and building predictive models that make a real business impact. You enjoy collaborating with cross‑functional teams, experimenting with new techniques, and delivering scalable analytical solutions.</p> <p>If you love transforming raw data into actionable insights and want to be part of a high‑performing analytics team at NICE Actimize, this role is for you.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>How will you make an impact?</strong></p> <p>You will join a dynamic team of highly skilled Data Scientists and Fraud Analytics experts working on cutting‑edge analytical solutions. In this role, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Work with large, complex datasets to analyze fraud cases and identify inconsistencies.</li> <li>Build, validate, and optimize machine learning models for fraud detection and prevention.</li> <li>Research data patterns to predict fraudulent transactions and improve model performance.</li> <li>Enhance existing models using advanced computational algorithms and techniques.</li> <li>Develop compelling visualizations that help stakeholders understand trends and insights.</li> <li>Collaborate with business teams, engineers, and stakeholders to deliver scalable analytical solutions.</li> <li>Drive continuous improvement by staying updated with the latest advancements in Data Science and ML.</li> <li>Communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non‑technical audiences.</li> <li>Participate in critical discussions, advocate technical solutions, and support model deployment.</li> <li>Contribute to innovation forums and knowledge‑sharing initiatives across NICE.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Have you got what it takes?</strong></p> <ul> <li>2 to 4 years of relevant Data Science experience.</li> <li>Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills.</li> <li>Ability to explain complex analytical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience working in agile, multi‑disciplinary teams.</li> <li>Self‑driven, collaborative, and committed to delivering high‑quality outcomes.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Qualifications &amp; Skills</strong></p> <p><strong>Core Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Advanced degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of statistical techniques (regression, feature selection, time series, etc.).</li> <li>Proficiency in SQL and Excel.</li> <li>Strong programming skills in Python (3.7+).</li> <li>Hands‑on experience with ML techniques (clustering, decision trees, boosting, etc.).</li> <li>Experience developing and deploying classification and regression models at enterprise scale.</li> <li>Understanding of logistic regression and regularization techniques.</li> <li>Familiarity with ML‑Ops frameworks or containerized environments (Kubernetes is a plus).</li> <li>Experience troubleshooting production data and deployed models.</li> <li>Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure preferred).</li> <li>Experience with visualization and presenting insights clearly.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Additional Desired Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in fraud analytics, financial crime, or risk management models.</li> <li>Knowledge of financial systems and data standards.</li> <li>Experience with containerized model development using Kubernetes.</li> <li>Exposure to banking or financial services domain.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you?</strong></p> <p>Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!</p> <p><strong>Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!</strong></p> <p>At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.</p> <p><strong>Requisition Details</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Requisition ID:</strong> 11631</li> <li><strong>Reporting into:</strong> Tech Manager, Actimize</li> <li><strong>Role Type:</strong> Individual Contributor</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>About NiCE </strong></em></p> <p><em>NICE Ltd. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div>

title: Dedicated Support Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>This position reports to our clients office in NYC and you'd be required to report to their office 4x a week. You will not be reporting to the NiCE Hoboken, NJ office.&nbsp;</strong></span></p> <p><br><br>The <strong>Dedicated Support Engineer (DSE)</strong>&nbsp;is a technical expert within NICE’s Technical Support organization, responsible for delivering proactive, and reactive support to large enterprise customers. Acting as a trusted advisor and technical liaison, the DSE ensures seamless incident resolution, system stability, and continuous improvement across customer environments.</p> <p>This role combines deep technical troubleshooting with strategic customer engagement, cross-functional collaboration, and operational excellence. The DSE supports managed services customers with a focus on incident management, change control, compliance, and governance.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>1. Incident &amp; Problem Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary contact for customer-raised incidents and service disruptions.</li> <li>Perform advanced troubleshooting across platforms including NICE, Avaya, Microsoft Teams, and more.</li> <li>Escalate complex issues to higher tier/vendors and drive resolution to closure.</li> <li>Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring issues and share insights with stakeholders.</li> <li>Ensure all incidents are resolved within agreed SLAs and maintain high CSAT.</li> </ul> <p><strong>2. Change &amp; Release Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Plan, test, and implement approved changes such as patches, upgrades, and configuration updates.</li> <li>Participate in CAB meetings, presenting impact and risk assessments.</li> <li>Ensure rollback strategies are documented and ready for critical changes.</li> <li>Maintain detailed documentation and implementation guides.</li> </ul> <p><strong>3. Monitoring &amp; Preventive Maintenance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Monitor system health and NICE monitoring.</li> <li>Conduct regular health checks and share proactive reports with customers.</li> <li>Identify performance bottlenecks and initiate preventive actions.</li> <li>Validate backup integrity, disaster recovery readiness, and patch compliance.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>4. General Provisioning &amp; Access Requests</strong></p> <ul> <li>Provisioning of new <strong>user/agent IDs</strong> in recording platforms.</li> <li>Assigning/adjusting <strong>recording profiles</strong> (voice, chat, screen).</li> <li>Provisioning access roles (e.g., Compliance Officer, Supervisor, Playback user).</li> <li>Profile setup for compliance/legal teams.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>5. Compliance &amp; Audit Support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ensure recording systems (voice/chat/video) meet regulatory and business compliance standards.</li> <li>Provide audit artifacts such as ticket logs, configuration snapshots, uptime reports, and RCA documentation.</li> <li>Support internal and external audits with evidence of control adherence.</li> </ul> <p><strong>6. Customer &amp; Stakeholder Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build strong relationships with customer stakeholders to align support with business priorities.</li> <li>Participate in governance calls, providing updates on incidents, SLAs, and satisfaction metrics.</li> <li>Handle escalations with professionalism and clarity, fostering trust and confidence.</li> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams including infrastructure, network, Microsoft, and security.</li> </ul> <p><strong>7. Knowledge &amp; Documentation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maintain and update SOPs, knowledge bases, and troubleshooting guides.</li> <li>Mentor backup engineers and onboard new team members to ensure knowledge continuity.</li> <li>Drive continuous improvement through automation and simplification of recurring tasks.</li> </ul> <p><strong>8. Project Support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support migration and upgrade projects such as NICE product deployments, and Teams recording transitions.</li> <li>Assist in solution validation, testing, and customer acceptance.</li> <li>Contribute to design documentation and participate in technical reviews.</li> </ul> <p><strong>9. Reporting &amp; Governance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prepare and present reports on uptime, incident trends, SLA adherence, and ticket analytics.</li> <li>Highlight risks and recurring issues, proposing long-term solutions.</li> <li>Provide visibility into resource utilization and operational performance.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Qualifications &amp; Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in a technology-related field or equivalent experience.</li> <li>ITIL Foundation (for SRF/support process adherence), Microsoft certifications (MS Teams, Azure Fundamentals/Administrator), Basic Networking (CCNA-level or equivalent).</li> <li>Familiarity with CTI integration (Avaya AES, Cisco CTI).</li> <li>Ticketing systems (ServiceNow, Remedy, ITSM tools).</li> <li>Log analysis (application logs, Windows Event Viewer, SIP traces).</li> <li>RCA documentation and preventive action planning.</li> <li>Basic SQL queries for DB (Oracle/SQL Server).</li> <li>Understanding of DB health monitoring and backup status.</li> <li>Windows Server administration (user permissions, patching, IIS), Active Directory integration with NICE, Virtualization platforms (VMware/Hyper-V).</li> <li>Microsoft Teams compliance recording enablement &amp; troubleshooting.</li> <li>SIP call flows related to recording.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Soft Skills / Service Orientation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong customer communication (handling compliance &amp; audit queries).</li> <li>Ability to document SOPs and knowledge base articles.</li> <li>Team collaboration and escalation management.</li> <li>Proactive monitoring and preventive issue identification.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>About NiCE </strong></em></p> <p><em>NICE Ltd. title: Event Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><h2>So, what’s the role all about?</h2> <p class="isSelectedEnd">As an <strong>Event Marketing Manager</strong>, you will own the event programs for NiCE’s Public Safety &amp; Justice business across two product lines: Evidencentral, supporting Justice, Defender and Investigator solutions, and NiCE Inform AI, supporting the 911 market.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">You will manage the full lifecycle of the event program — from building the annual calendar and managing event logistics through on-site execution, lead capture, post-event handoff and follow-up. Supporting two distinct sales teams and go-to-market motions, you will ensure each event is strategically planned, effectively executed and positioned to generate measurable pipeline.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Events are a critical demand-generation channel within the Public Safety &amp; Justice market, where relationships are often built in person and through professional associations. Your role will be to make sure we maximize that opportunity before, during and after every event.</p> <h2>How will you make an impact?</h2> <ul data-spread="false"> <li>Own the annual event calendar across both Public Safety &amp; Justice product lines, evaluating national, state and regional opportunities and recommending which events to renew, consolidate, expand or discontinue.</li> <li>Balance the event portfolio across key audiences, including prosecutors, defenders, law enforcement agencies and 911 organizations.</li> <li>Develop distinct event strategies for each product line and sales team, recognizing the different go-to-market motions across Evidencentral and NiCE Inform AI.</li> <li>Contribute to event budget planning by providing show-level performance data and recommendations that help determine investment across both product lines.</li> <li>Track event spend throughout the year, negotiate with vendors, monitor variances and reconcile actual costs against planned investment.</li> <li>Partner with Procurement to manage vendor onboarding, requisitions, purchase orders, invoices, approvals and payments while ensuring critical sponsorship and event deadlines are met.</li> <li>Manage end-to-end event logistics, including sponsorships, contracts, booth space and design, shipping, collateral, demo hardware, staffing, room blocks, speaking opportunities, award submissions and association deliverables.</li> <li>Develop a detailed run of show and staffing plan for each event in partnership with the appropriate sales team.</li> <li>Own on-site execution for priority events, including booth operations, staffing schedules, demo stations, pre-booked meetings and lead-capture processes.</li> <li>Plan and execute customer and partner engagements including dinners, receptions, hospitality events and small-group gatherings.</li> <li>Coordinate guest lists, venues, menus, timing, internal attendance and post-event follow-up while ensuring compliance with applicable gift and hospitality policies.</li> <li>Establish the lead-capture strategy before each event, including required fields, qualification criteria, campaign setup and naming conventions.</li> <li>Collect, clean, de-duplicate and enrich event leads before handing them to the Marketing Analyst for upload into Salesforce against the appropriate campaign.</li> <li>Maintain strong attribution hygiene by ensuring event leads reach Salesforce with accurate campaign and source information.</li> <li>Partner with each sales team before events to establish the post-event follow-up strategy, including segmentation, messaging and lead-selection criteria.</li> <li>Adapt and personalize post-event Outreach sequences based on the event, audience, product line and conversations generated at the show.</li> <li>Provide SDR teams with clean, enriched lead lists and recommendations regarding lead priority, agency information and relevant event context.</li> <li>Launch Outreach sequences according to the agreed post-event schedule and help ensure timely follow-up.</li> <li>Build and maintain relationships with professional associations across the Public Safety &amp; Justice market and identify opportunities to increase NiCE’s presence and engagement.</li> <li>Partner with the broader marketing organization to ensure each event has a clear next step for attendees, including webinars, landing pages and relevant content.</li> <li>Use AI tools including Claude and Microsoft Copilot to support follow-up content, lead cleanup and de-duplication, event analysis, post-event summaries and recurring reporting.</li> </ul> <h2>Have you got what it takes?</h2> <ul data-spread="false"> <li>5+ years of experience planning and executing B2B trade shows, conferences and events end to end, including direct on-site ownership.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience owning the post-event lead lifecycle, including lead capture, data hygiene and enrichment, campaign attribution and sales handoff.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Salesforce for campaign management and attribution.</li> <li>Experience using Monday.com or a similar project management platform to manage event plans, timelines, deliverables and cross-functional visibility.</li> <li>Experience cleaning and enriching event lead data, including de-duplication, missing-field completion and company, agency or title normalization.</li> <li>Experience with data enrichment platforms such as ZoomInfo or similar tools.</li> <li>Working knowledge of a sales engagement platform such as Outreach, including the ability to segment leads, build and launch sequences and support effective sales handoffs.</li> <li>Proven ability to support multiple sales teams, product lines or business priorities simultaneously.</li> <li>Experience tracking event spend, negotiating with vendors and managing purchase orders, invoices and reconciliation.</li> <li>Ability to navigate corporate procurement processes and manage vendor relationships through payment completion.</li> <li>Fluency using AI tools such as Claude and Microsoft Copilot for practical business applications including drafting, data cleanup, analysis and reporting.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to create clear event plans, staffing briefs, follow-up strategies and post-event reporting.</li> <li>Strong organizational skills and attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple events, stakeholders and deadlines simultaneously.</li> <li>Willingness to travel approximately 10–15% and work event hours as required.</li> </ul> <h2>You will have an advantage if you also have:</h2> <ul data-spread="false"> <li>Experience marketing to the public sector, government, justice or public safety markets.</li> <li>Experience working with professional associations or association-led marketing programs.</li> <li>Experience managing association co-sponsored programs, sponsorships or speaking opportunities.</li> <li>Familiarity with marketing automation platforms such as Marketo or similar solutions.</li> <li>Understanding of marketing campaign logic, funnel reporting and event-driven demand generation.</li> <li>Certified Meeting Professional (CMP) certification.</li> </ul> <h2>Your first 90 days</h2> <p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>First 30 days</strong></p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Build a strong understanding of the Public Safety &amp; Justice business, both product lines and their respective sales motions. Review the committed event calendar, meet key stakeholders across both sales teams and Marketing, evaluate historical event performance and document the existing lead-to-Salesforce and Outreach process.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>By 60 days</strong></p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Establish a consistent pre-event and post-event operating model across both sales teams, including lead-capture requirements, campaign naming, handoff expectations, follow-up sequences and lead-selection criteria. Begin applying this approach to upcoming events.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>By 90 days</strong></p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Develop an evidence-based recommendation for the next event planning cycle, identifying which events should be renewed, expanded, consolidated or reconsidered based on performance, pipeline contribution and actual spend.</p> <h2>What’s in it for you?</h2> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Public Safety &amp; Justice is a growth business within NiCE and operates in a market where events play a meaningful role in originating demand and building relationships.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">You will have visible influence over how our event strategy is developed across two product lines, with a direct line of sight from event engagement through lead generation and pipeline creation. You will also have the opportunity to shape how the entire event follow-up process operates — ensuring great conversations become measurable business opportunities.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where teams are highly collaborative, opportunities for impact are significant and the work supports organizations providing critical public safety and justice services.</p> <h2>Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!</h2> <p class="isSelectedEnd">At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: two days working from the office and three days of remote work each week. Office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaboration fuel innovation and new ideas.</p> <p>This role will be filled on a NiCE-FLEX hybrid, with approximately 10–15% travel expected. On-site attendance will primarily focus on larger national and strategic events where in-person participation provides the greatest value.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>About NiCE </strong></em></p> <p><em>NICE Ltd. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div>

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>So, what's the role all about?</strong></p> <p>The Global Partner Program Manager drives the next phase of an established, global partner program spanning multiple partner types and routes-to-market. This role is accountable for program evolution and operational excellence: clarifying program mechanics, improving partner experience and adoption, tightening governance, and building a consistent global operating rhythm across regions and functions. You will work cross-functionally with Partner Sales/Alliances, Marketing, Enablement, Operations, Product, Finance, and Systems teams to ensure the program is measurable, scalable, and repeatable, with clear KPIs and strong execution discipline.</p> <p><strong>How will you make an impact</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and continuously improve the partner program framework (tiers/levels, benefits, requirements, rules of engagement, lifecycle milestones), including program documentation and decisioning—ensuring clarity on what changes, why, who approves, and how it rolls out globally</li> <li>Build and run the program's global operating cadence (QBR/MBR inputs, monthly updates, enablement drops, partner communications calendar)</li> <li>Partner with regional leaders to balance global consistency with regional execution flexibility</li> <li>Improve partner onboarding and activation by creating repeatable playbooks, checklists, and readiness milestones—and build feedback loops (surveys, partner councils, regional listening) to translate partner insights into program improvements</li> <li>Map current-to-future-state processes and remove friction through workflow redesign and automation of partner program operations (intake, approvals, entitlement requests, program changes)</li> <li>Ensure the program is supported by strong systems and data (CRM/PRM alignment, reporting hygiene, scalable workflows)</li> <li>Build toolkits and templates that enable scale (FAQs, partner-facing guides, internal playbooks, global comms templates)</li> <li>Evolve and operationalize Regulatory Alignment</h4> <ul> <li>Ensure all solutions and consulting engagements align with sovereign cloud requirements, including data residency and security controls</li> <li>Collaborate with customers to design compliant architectures within Australian and APAC regulatory frameworks</li> <li>Provide guidance on risk, governance, and compliance in cloud-based CX and AI implementations</li> <li>Align transformation strategies with public sector and regulated industry expectations</li> </ul> <h4>Stakeholder Engagement &amp; Advisory</h4> <ul> <li>Act as trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, including C-suite</li> <li>Lead strategic discussions and influence decision-making</li> <li>Ensure stakeholder alignment and sponsorship</li> <li>Operate effectively across matrixed teams</li> </ul> <h4>CX &amp; title: Partner Value Solution Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>So, what’s the role all about?</strong></p> <p class="x_MsoNormal"><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">The NiCE <strong>Partner Value Solution Engineer </strong>is apart of the excellence team that is dedicated to empowering NiCE's partner ecosystem to confidently position, sell, and deliver NiCE solutions. As a key member of this team, you will serve as the expert technical bridge between NiCE and its partners, equipping them with the knowledge, tools, and assets needed to create differentiated customer outcomes. You will act as a trusted technical go-to-market advisor, guiding partners from supported consumers of NiCE technology into self-sufficient, high-performing advocates.</span></p> <p class="x_MsoNormal">This is a multifaceted role that spans sales engineering, technical enablement, technical account management, and services, all united by a single goal: increasing revenue and win rates by making partners effective at selling and delivering NiCE solutions.&nbsp; A core focus of this position is owning partner readiness across NiCE's AI portfolio, including conversational AI, virtual agents, agent assist, automation, and AI-driven customer experience use cases. &nbsp;You will equip partners with the skills and knowledge to translate customer business problems into concrete AI solution designs, guiding them through discovery, use-case qualification, success criteria definition, demo flows, proof-of-value and pilot execution, and the development of measurable outcome narratives.</p> <p class="x_MsoNormal">In addition, you will provide expert guidance on AI architecture, integrations, data requirements, model behavior, governance, and responsible AI considerations, ensuring partners can confidently design and position solutions that are technically sound and ethically grounded.</p> <p><strong><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Qualifications</span></strong></p> <ul type="disc"> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Experience with AI, conversational AI, virtual agents, agent assist, or automation in CX/contact center environments</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">The ability to translate business outcomes into AI use cases and success criteria</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Working knowledge of LLMs, generative AI, AI orchestration, integrations, and responsible AI principles; and experience supporting AI PoVs, pilots, or customer validation motions.</li> </ul> <p class="x_MsoNormal"><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p class="x_MsoNormal"><em><strong>Sales Engineering</strong>:</em> You will lead technical discovery engagements with partners, mapping customer requirements to joint solutions and NiCE's CCaaS/AI capabilities. You'll support tailored demos and proof-of-concept (POC) engagements that highlight integrated partner–vendor value, and serve as the technical trusted advisor helping partners shape architectures, proposals, and ROI narratives that win deals.</p> <ul type="disc"> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Increase partner revenue and win rates by making partners effective at selling and delivering NiCE solutions</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Qualify AI use cases based on business value, technical feasibility, data readiness, and measurable outcomes.</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Support AI-focused demos and PoVs that show business impact, not just capability.</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Lead technical discovery sessions with partners</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Map partner and customer requirements to joint solutions and CCaaS/AI capabilities</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Support tailored demos that showcase integrated partner–vendor value rather than standalone features</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Support proof-of-concept (POC) engagements with partners</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Act as the technical trusted advisor to partner teams</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Help acquire / validate architectures for customer solutions</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Assist in crafting ROI stories that demonstrate joint solution value</li> </ul> <p class="x_MsoNormal"><strong><em>Technical Enablement</em></strong>: You will build and deliver repeatable technical enablement programs to ramp partner SEs and solution architects. This includes maintaining partner-facing assets such as reference architectures, integration guides, and battlecards in the partner portal. You'll run ongoing readiness programs, webinars, office hours, and 30–60–90 day plans, to keep partners current on product updates, roadmap direction, and best practices.</p> <ul type="disc"> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Make partners as self-sufficient and effective as the NiCE SE team</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Build AI-specific enablement around conversational design, prompt/design patterns, use-case discovery, PoV execution, responsible AI, and outcome measurement.</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Track partner feedback on AI capabilities, implementation friction, model behavior, integration gaps, and roadmap needs.</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Help partners understand release impacts tied to AI features, model updates, data dependencies, and governance.</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Includes building reusable demo scripts, talk tracks, objection handling, and competitive positioning.</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Ensure partner enablement stays aligned with the account team's strategy</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Build repeatable technical enablement programs for partner SEs and architects</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Deliver enablement to ramp new partner technical staff</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Support competitive differentiators for partner teams</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Keep partners current on product updates and new features</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Keep partners aligned with the NiCE product roadmap</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Share best practices across the partner ecosystem</li> </ul> <p class="x_MsoNormal"><em><strong>Technical Account Management</strong>: </em>You will own the end-to-end technical relationship with key partners, managing integration patterns, release impact assessments, and escalation paths. You'll coordinate with Product and R&amp;D to surface partner-driven requirements and influence the product roadmap. You'll also govern architecture, security, and performance standards across partner solutions to ensure they meet joint quality benchmarks.</p> <ul type="disc"> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Ensure NiCE technology reliably delivers business value for customers</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Manage integration patterns across partner solutions</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Assess and communicate release impact to partners</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Assist in escalation paths for technical issues</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Coordinate with Product and R&amp;D teams on partner-driven requirements</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Manage and track technical feedback from partners</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Influence the NiCE product roadmap based on partner input</li> </ul> <p class="x_MsoNormal"><em><strong>Services</strong>: </em>You will support scoping of services for partner-led implementations, including estimates, SOW inputs, and responsibilities matrices. You'll provide architectural oversight on complex deployments to ensure technical deliverability of what was sold, and capture lessons learned to feed back into patterns, templates, and future partner enablement.</p> <ul type="disc"> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Support validation of services for partner-led implementations</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Provide architectural oversight on complex partner deployments</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Conduct advisory reviews on challenging implementation scenarios</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Capture lessons learned from completed partner engagements</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Feed lessons learned back into patterns and templates</li> </ul> <p class="x_MsoNormal"><strong>Mission &amp; Purpose</strong></p> <ul type="disc"> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Empower the partner ecosystem to confidently position, sell, and deliver NiCE solutions</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Provide expert support, enablement, and collaboration that showcases the full value of the platform</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Equip partners with the knowledge, tools, and assets needed to create differentiated customer outcomes</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Serve as a trusted technical go-to-market advisor for partners on strategic opportunities and joint offerings</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Drive ongoing enablement to transition partners from supported consumers to self-sufficient advocates<strong>&nbsp;</strong></li> </ul> <p class="x_MsoNormal"><strong>&nbsp;</strong><strong>What’s in it for you?</strong></p> <p>Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! Program Scalability</strong></p> <ul> <li>Evaluate existing workflows and design program improvements that reduce friction and increase transparency.</li> <li>Implement automation, templates, AI-driven tools, and standardized processes to create operational scale.</li> <li>Lead initiatives that improve performance visibility, streamline data sources, and enhance organizational readiness for leadership reviews.</li> <li>Partner with system owners and cross-functional teams to improve Salesforce usability, reporting structures, and data integrity.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Have you got what it takes?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Program &amp; negotiations of these renewals.&nbsp;</p> <p>Specifically, this position is responsible for retaining customers during the negotiation process, growing and retaining revenue with annual or CPI increases and specific product additions, and meeting team and individual goals related to their tasks.</p> <p><strong>How will you make an impact?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prepare and analyze financial reports and contractual documents ahead of internal renewal meetings to facilitate informed discussions.</li> <li>Engage directly with clients to understand their goals and desired outcomes for contract renewals, ensuring alignment with business objectives and customer expectations.</li> <li>Negotiating contract terms, pricing, and other details to achieve favorable outcomes for both the company and the customer, which will maintain and increase revenue through effective contract negotiations</li> <li>Partner with SAMs, AEs, Technical Account Managers (TAMs) and the Finance team to represent the best interest of NiCE and revenue retention goals</li> <li>Partner with the finance team to ensure healthy price points</li> <li>Extending contracts for multiple years</li> <li>Become intimately familiar with customer contracts and NiCE billing methods</li> <li>Maintain working knowledge of competitors and what strategy NiCE should develop for counter offers and retaining the customer.</li> <li>Maintain working knowledge of NiCE products/services</li> <li>Partner with TAMs, SAMs, and AEs to ensure consistent messaging to the customer</li> <li>Measure success via tracking of client retention and revenue growth with multiple sources such as Salesforce and Excel.</li> <li>Communicate effectively and professionally with internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Investigate areas of risk and prepare course of action/recommendations to minimize risk</li> <li>Create and prepare contract documents, presentations, emails, and spreadsheets to support contract management activities</li> </ul> <p><strong>Have you got what it takes?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or Business Administration or related field or equivalent work experience</li> <li>4+ years applicable experience in contract negotiation</li> <li>4+ years in contact center or service delivery</li> <li>Experience with SAAS billing models</li> <li>Demonstrated experience in a fast-paced environment and meeting customer contract timelines</li> <li>Demonstrated experience working independently with little to no daily supervision</li> <li>Ability to pivot and reporting on renewal metrics, such as renewal rates.</li> <li>To be innovative with strategic ideas and approaches in negotiation</li> <li>To have Problem solving and critical thinking skills</li> And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><div><strong data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Senior Accountant</strong>&nbsp;</div> <div><em>Location: Sandy, UT (hybrid, 2 days per week in office)</em>&nbsp;</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><strong>So, what’s the role all about?</strong>&nbsp;</div> <div>As a Senior Accountant, you’ll play an important role in supporting a well-established, publicly traded SaaS business with a collaborative revenue accounting function. You’ll work closely with cross‑functional partners to ensure revenue is accounted for accurately and consistently, while helping maintain the strong processes and controls expected of a mature public company. &nbsp;</div> <div>This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex accounting questions, contributing to reliable financial reporting, and continuously improving processes in an&nbsp;evolving SaaS environment.&nbsp;</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><strong>How will you make an impact?</strong>&nbsp;</div> <ul> <li>Support the revenue accounting process&nbsp;in accordance with&nbsp;ASC 606, including participation in contract review, assessment of performance obligations, evaluation of transaction price, and allocation and recognition of revenue for assigned areas.&nbsp;</li> <li>Review customer contracts, amendments, renewals, and modifications, and partner closely with Sales, Deal Desk, Legal, FP&amp;A, and Order Management<strong>&nbsp;to</strong>&nbsp;ensure&nbsp;appropriate revenue&nbsp;treatment for standard and&nbsp;nonstandard&nbsp;terms.&nbsp;</li> <li>Manage monthly and quarterly revenue close activities, ensuring revenue is recorded accurately, completely, and in compliance with US GAAP and&nbsp;public company&nbsp;reporting requirements.&nbsp;</li> <li>Prepare and review&nbsp;revenue related&nbsp;journal entries, including deferred revenue, contract assets, and contract liabilities.&nbsp;</li> <li>Maintain reconciliations for&nbsp;revenue related&nbsp;balance sheet accounts, investigate variances, and ensure&nbsp;timely&nbsp;resolution of discrepancies.&nbsp;</li> <li>Own the revenue subledger and ensure alignment between operational systems and the general ledger.&nbsp;</li> <li>Support SOX 404 controls&nbsp;related to&nbsp;revenue by documenting processes,&nbsp;maintaining&nbsp;supporting evidence, and&nbsp;participating&nbsp;in control walkthroughs and testing.&nbsp;</li> <li>Serve as a primary point of contact for external auditors&nbsp;for&nbsp;revenue related&nbsp;matters, including preparation of audit schedules, technical accounting support, and responses to audit inquiries.&nbsp;</li> <li>Draft and&nbsp;maintain&nbsp;revenue accounting policies, procedures, and technical accounting memos, including documentation for complex revenue arrangements.&nbsp;</li> <li>Partner with FP&amp;A to support revenue forecasting, backlog reporting, and analysis of bookings, billings, and revenue trends.&nbsp;</li> <li>Prepare quarterly and annual revenue disclosures for public filings, including deferred revenue&nbsp;roll forwards&nbsp;and contract balance disclosures.&nbsp;</li> <li>Support system integrations, enhancements, and process improvements related to revenue accounting, including scalability, automation, and internal control effectiveness.&nbsp;</li> <li>Ensure data integrity across revenue systems, billing platforms,&nbsp;manual schedules,&nbsp;and cloud ERP systems (e.g., Workday Financials)<strong>.</strong>&nbsp;</li> <li>Provide guidance and mentorship to junior accountants or offshore team members on revenue accounting processes and close responsibilities.&nbsp;</li> <li>Continuously&nbsp;identify&nbsp;opportunities to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and control within the revenue accounting function in a&nbsp;high growth&nbsp;SaaS environment.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <div><strong>Have&nbsp;you got what it takes?</strong>&nbsp;</div> <ul> <li>5+ years of progressive accounting experience,&nbsp;ideally including&nbsp;SaaS revenue&nbsp;experience in a multi-entity, multi-region environment.&nbsp;</li> <li>BA/BS in Accounting or Finance.&nbsp;</li> <li>CPA preferred.&nbsp;</li> <li>Public company or Big 4 background.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <div><strong>Skills and Tools</strong>&nbsp;</div> <ul> <li>Strong communication, writing, financial analysis, and interpersonal skills.&nbsp;</li> <li>Intermediate Excel&nbsp;skills.&nbsp;</li> <li>Hands-on experience with&nbsp;Workday Financials&nbsp;(or strong experience with a comparable cloud ERP and clear willingness to ramp on Workday).&nbsp;</li> <li>Comfort working across systems and pulling, reconciling, and analyzing data from multiple sources.&nbsp;</li> <li>Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage competing priorities.&nbsp;</li> <li>Proven ability to communicate and influence at all levels of an organization.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>About NiCE </strong></em></p> <p><em>NICE Ltd. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>So what is the role all about?</strong></p> <p>The Senior Agentic Systems Engineer is a hands-on engineer who designs, builds, and operates AI-powered tools and workflows for engineering teams.</p> <p>We’re looking for builders who are not only users of AI tools, but can design autonomous agentic systems, optimize model usage, create reusable agents and workflows, and orchestrate complex multi-step work across multiple tools and agents.</p> <p>You’ll be a “one-person-army” builder: able to understand a problem, define the approach, build the backend, create a simple UI when needed, integrate APIs, connect agents, automate workflows, and deliver working tools quickly.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>How will you make an impact?</strong></p> <ul> <li value="1">Build centralized AI-powered tools for engineering teams.</li> <li value="2">Create and token economy thinking when designing agents, prompts, MCP usage, RAG flows, and tool integrations.</li> <li value="10">Contribute to the internal AI marketplace and reusable asset catalog.</li> <li value="11">Work directly with engineering teams, collect feedback, and iterate quickly.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Have you got what it takes?</strong></p> <div> <ul> <li>Strong practical experience with LLMs and AI-assisted development.</li> <li>Experience designing, building, and orchestrating autonomous agentic systems and multi-agent workflows for internal or external automation.</li> <li>Experience with agents, skills, MCP servers and development, plugins, RAG, embeddings, and AI orchestration frameworks.</li> <li>Ability to orchestrate complex, multi-step work across cooperating agents and tools.</li> <li>Deep understanding of token economy, model selection, prompt/context design, and AI workflow optimization for cost, latency, speed, quality, accuracy, and reliability.</li> <li>Deep, current knowledge of the AI tooling and coding-agent ecosystem, such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex, or similar.</li> <li>Experience with telemetry, dashboards, and AI usage analytics.</li> <li>Strong hands-on software engineering experience.</li> <li>Full-stack capability: backend, APIs, automation, and basic frontend when needed.</li> ability to translate engineering pain points into practical tools and solutions.</li> <li>Ability to design, deliver, and own working solutions independently.</li> <li>Comfortable working with ambiguity and rapidly evolving technologies.</li> </ul> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!</strong></p> <p>At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum
